entries.description: Surveyed 5 canonical reports' footer aggregate controls (closed set = Sum only) and routed the parser-vs-evaluator design fork to cross-provider analysis.

Added FooterAggregateControl + DisplayTotal types; extended ReportLiveSpec / ReportAggregateInput / ReportAggregates; extended AccessReportSpecReader to capture footer-section text boxes (report footer + group footers) via COM; threaded FooterAggregates through ReportBaselineRunner.

Implemented SumAggregateEvaluator (tokenizer + recursive-descent parser + decimal evaluator for the closed Sum(<arith>) grammar) and wired ReportAggregateComputer.ComputeDisplayTotals to emit DisplayTotals for derivable report-footer Sum aggregates and route everything else (group footers, RunningSum, IIf/unsupported functions, control refs, unresolved/non-numeric columns, parse errors, overflow) to Skipped with grounded reasons. Kept AggregateContract='RecordSourceResultSet' (additive DisplayTotals field), updated ContractNote.

Added hermetic xUnit tests (SumAggregateEvaluatorTests + DisplayTotals cases in ReportAggregateComputerTests + writer serialization). Full-solution build succeeded (0 errors). Hermetic suites green: 100 ReportBaseline tests, 684 Pipeline.Tests. Live COM capture slice against rptInvoice computed txtSubTotal=Sum((1-[Discount])*[Quantity]*[UnitPrice])=50313.622 over 130 rows; txtShipping/txtTotal/txtTax (IIf) correctly routed to Skipped.
Cross-provider session verification round 2 (fixes for R1 Major/Major/Minor).
Routed the PDF-spot-check output-location design fork to cross-provider consensus; both GPT-5.4 and Gemini Pro independently chose Option A (non-gated reports-baseline-spot-check sibling).

Implemented Option A: ReportBaselineRunner writes PDFs + spot-check-manifest.json into a separate non-gated spotCheckRoot (new SpotCheckManifest/Writer); gated baseline-manifest.json stays PDF-free; render failure non-blocking; added a PathsOverlap disjointness guard. Updated CLI command + help + BaselineManifest docs.

Regenerated the committed reports-baseline/ golden corpus for both fixtures via the new guarded GoldenCorpusRegenerator (AH_REGEN_GOLDEN env + Skip.IfNot) reusing the exact GoldenNormalizer; each aggregates.json now carries DisplayTotals + the updated ContractNote.

Confirmed CanonicalGoldenRegressionTests passes 2/2 byte-for-byte against the regenerated corpus; rewrote hermetic ReportBaselineRunnerTests (18/18) and updated the COM integration test for the sibling spot-check; full hermetic suites green (1,747).
Updated both fixture READ-ME-FIRST.md, interpretation-guide section 5.2 (DisplayTotals + spot-check sibling, fixed stale deferred note), and the ROADMAP; updated ai-assignment.md Session 2 actuals.

Cross-provider session verification round 1; ISSUES_FOUND with two Minor findings (spotCheckRoot/reportsBaselineRoot disjointness not enforced at API boundary; missing includePdf+ReadSpecFailed spot-check test).
Fixed both Minor findings (PathsOverlap guard + 3 new tests) and re-verified; round 2 returned VERIFIED.

Routed the next-session-set recommendation (Rule 17): re-measured the flaky COM tests (classify HHC persistent 240s timeout; sanitize HHC one-off flake, passed on retry); recommendation = harvester-fix-classify-timeout.
